body: A no-break space after dispatch://CORE-14 and an ideographic one after dispatch://CORE-15　end
Neither a vertical tab nor a BOM ends one: dispatch://CORE-18 dispatch://CORE-19﻿.
A % that two hex digits do not follow stays a %: https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-3/spec?comment=c%2%34 here

A control character or a BOM after a slug or an id: dispatch://CORE-1/artifact/notes-md dispatch://CORE-1/comment/c1 dispatch://CORE/artifact/handbook-md https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-1/asks/a1 dispatch://CORE-1/ask/a1﻿

An id decoding to a NUL: dispatch://CORE-1/comment/%00, https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-1/comments/%00, https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-1/spec?comment=%2500, https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-1/spec?comment=%00 and dispatch://CORE/artifact/handbook-md/comment/%00

A slug is all of its segment and a version has no leading zero: dispatch://CORE-1/artifact/notes-md!x, dispatch://CORE/artifact/Notes-md, https://dispatch.test/issues/CORE-1/artifacts/notes_md and dispatch://CORE-1/artifact/notes-md@v03
